pages.text: A $(#AA00AA)Djinni$() is bound to the ender satchel, tasked with $(bold)slightly$() warping the space.$(br) This allows open your ender chest from anywhere, making it a practical traveller's companion.$(br2)

pages.title: Inventory Sharing
pages.text: Additionally, using $(#AA00AA)Shift + Right-Click$() will bind the satchel to you,$(br) allowing to share your ender chest with any other player,$(br) making this a great way to send items over long distances to friends.$(br)
